# We build global champions

###### GardaWorld is an entrepreneurial-driven corporation that builds global champions in security
###### services, AI-enabled security technologies, integrated risk management and cash automation
###### solutions. Powered by intelligent proprietary software platforms and a workforce of 132,000+
###### skilled and dedicated professionals, GardaWorld has forged close partnerships with the
###### world’s most prominent corporations and governments.

[LEARN MORE][14]

## Our high-growth businesses dominate in their markets

Our global champion businesses are united by a dedication to operational excellence, innovation and
adaptability, and uncommon value creation.

In 2025, GardaWorld was valued at C$14 billion in the largest private buyout in Canadian history.
This transaction saw Founder, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer, Stephan Crétier and
members of the senior management team assume majority ownership of GardaWorld, underscoring its true

## 50 años siendo Pro

**Celebramos nuestro 50 aniversario, orgullosos por todo lo conseguido, pero mirando hacia adelante
para seguir liderando el futuro de la seguridad.**

180.000 profesionales presentes en 36 países y 5 continentes a través de sus 4 líneas de negocio,
haciendo del mundo un lugar más seguro.

[ ][77]

## Ser "Pro" es lo que nos define.

**Nuestra esencia es ser PRO. Lo llevamos en nuestro ADN, en nuestro propio nombre y es parte de
nuestra esencia.**

**Lo que nos hace innovar y liderar. PRO de profesionalidad, proactividad y protección. PRO de
proyecto y propósito. 50 años siendo PRO.**

###

###

###  

Soluciones de Logística, Gestión y Automatización de efectivo a Instituciones Financieras, Bancos,

**Celebramos nuestro 50 aniversario, orgullosos por todo lo conseguido, pero mirando hacia adelante
para seguir liderando el futuro de la seguridad.**

180.000 profesionales presentes en 36 países y 5 continentes a través de sus 4 líneas de negocio,
haciendo del mundo un lugar más seguro.

**Nuestra esencia es ser PRO. Lo llevamos en nuestro ADN, en nuestro propio nombre y es parte de
nuestra esencia.**

proyecto y propósito. 50 años siendo PRO.**

## Featured Products

## [Innovative Solutions][339]

Seamlessly integrated with Johnson Controls' Video Surveillance and Access Control platforms, these
AI-powered solutions can work both independently and in concert to manage risks.

[[illustra pro thermal camera]][340]

## [Illustra ProGen 4 Cameras ][341]


Built-in AI based object classification for enhanced situational awareness and security automation.

 

[Tyco Cloud Video Surveillance system]

## CloudVue

One cloud platform for everything security

[Aerial view of a city]

## A Valuable Partner: Learn More About Tyco

Getting the right solution to the right customer demands partnership, and Tyco relies on
integrators, consultants, distributors, dealers and installers—and their collective expertise—around
the world. We’re committed to helping our partners in our shared mission: to keep people, property,
and assets safe.

## Expand Your Security Opportunities

We provide a higher level of commitment to and integration for all your physical and digital
security needs.

[[Cyber Security Solutions]][342]

## [Cyber Solutions][343]

Tyco provides cyber-resilient systems with a range of capabilities to address the diverse security
needs of our customers.

[[Cyber Security Solutions]][344]

## [Connected Partner Program][345]

We help technology partners integrate their third-party solutions with our in-house brands to
leverage our sales teams and market on a global scale.

# We protect what matters most

Scroll down

## Verisure is the global leader by customers served in professionally monitored security services,
## with a market-leading presence across Europe and Latin America

Every day, our dedicated teams use leading technology to protect ~6.3 million families and small
businesses across 18 countries.

With over 35 years of insights, experience, and innovation, Verisure is known for category-creating
marketing, sales excellence, innovative products and services, and customer-centricity.

[ Learn more ][99] Learn more

## Why Verisure is unique

We provide peace of mind for families and small businesses.

We are the leader in professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America.

We are always innovating and providing the best technology and products to protect our customers.

We are committed to keeping our customers secure.

## 24/7 protection

With our award-winning alarm technology

We are a technology-enabled human services company, and our people stand ready to respond in an
instant to protect what matters most.

## Verisure in numbers

24/7

response

~6.3 million

customers

in Europe and Latin America

## We are people protecting people, enabled by technology

### We provide immediate human response powered by trusted and innovative technology.

We deter intruders, detect when an alarm is triggered, take rapid action to verify the intrusion and
reassure the customer or intervene.

[ Discover our service ][100] Discover our service
 

## Innovation at Verisure

Over 1,800 technologists work across our three in-house technology and innovation centres in Malmö,
Madrid and Geneva, developing and delivering products and services based on the insights gained from
our daily interactions with customers.

## Verisure is the global leader by customers served in professionally monitored security services,
## with a market-leading presence across Europe and Latin America

Every day, our dedicated teams use leading technology to protect ~6.3 million families and small
businesses across 18 countries.

With over 35 years of insights, experience, and innovation, Verisure is known for category-creating
marketing, sales excellence, innovative products and services, and customer-centricity.

[ Learn more ][99] Learn more

## Why Verisure is unique

We provide peace of mind for families and small businesses.

We are the leader in professionally monitored security services in Europe and Latin America.

We are always innovating and providing the best technology and products to protect our customers.

We are committed to keeping our customers secure.

## 24/7 protection

With our award-winning alarm technology

We are a technology-enabled human services company, and our people stand ready to respond in an
instant to protect what matters most.

## Verisure in numbers

### We provide immediate human response powered by trusted and innovative technology.

We deter intruders, detect when an alarm is triggered, take rapid action to verify the intrusion and
reassure the customer or intervene.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

# Engineered Cooling Solutions for Long-Term Performance

### High-Efficiency Industrial Cooling Towers

Explore how Auscooling designs and manufactures robust cooling systems tailored to withstand harsh
Australian conditions while optimising thermal efficiency.

[Send Enquiry][17]

## Who We Are

Auscooling is a specialist cooling tower manufacturer and service provider. We design, build, and
maintain high-performance cooling systems that help industrial plants and HVAC operations run
safely, reliably, and efficiently.

[Learn More][18]

#### Reliable Systems for Demanding Environments

## Engineered for Thermal Efficiency



#### Resource Preservation

Our cooling designs focus on water conservation, drift reduction, and durable materials that limit
environmental footprint.



#### Bespoke Configurations

Every plant has unique requirements. We configure each system to match your physical site layout and
specific thermal load requirements.



#### Optimised Power Usage

Through advanced fan and motor selection, our towers minimise electricity draw while maintaining
targeted water temperatures.



#### Durable Construction

Using corrosion-resistant structural components, our towers are built to last in highly saline or
industrial atmospheres.

## Specialist Engineering & Thermal Expertise

We bring decades of technical knowledge to industrial heat transfer. From design to maintenance, we
focus on engineering robust solutions that prevent downtime and maintain safe operations.



#### Bespoke Engineering & Design

We design cooling towers from the ground up, ensuring they are sized precisely for your plant's
wet-bulb temperatures and space constraints.



#### Precision Assembly & Commissioning

Our experienced site crew manages the full mechanical installation and hot commissioning to
guarantee immediate, reliable operation.



#### Preventative Maintenance & Refurbishment

Keep your towers running safely with scheduled inspections, component replacements, and thermal
upgrades designed to extend structure life.



#### Thermal Upgrades & Optimisation

We audit existing cooling towers to identify bottlenecks, upgrading fills and nozzle distribution
systems to reclaim lost thermal capacity.

#### Reliable Cooling Across Key Industries

## Serving Vital Sectors



## Power Generation

Optimising turbine performance and heat rejection in high-capacity power stations.



## Oil & Gas

Delivering heavy-duty, explosion-proof cooling solutions for complex refineries and processing
plants.



## Commercial HVAC

Ensuring energy-efficient, low-noise cooling systems for commercial buildings and district cooling
networks.



## Heavy Industry & Manufacturing

Managing high-temperature process cooling loops for smelting, refining, and manufacturing
facilities.

[& Many More][19]

#### Our

## Products

# FRP IDCT

Rapid modular installationSeismically rated and structurally engineeredRelocatable and expandable
cell layoutsProven track record across large industrial sitesCapacity for high-volume cell
configurations

# RCC IDCT

Reinforced concrete designs offer unmatched durability for large-scale power and industrial process
water loops.

# Package Cooling Towers

Compact, low-noise FRP cooling towers designed for commercial premises, hospitals, and
noise-sensitive urban environments.

[View all Products][20]

#### Our

## Services



#### Structural & Mechanical Inspections

As critical plant assets, cooling towers require regular structural audits. Our engineers conduct
thorough condition inspections, identifying potential structural decay or mechanical wear early to
prevent costly unscheduled downtime.

l

#### Thermal Performance Audits

We perform detailed thermal assessments to verify if your towers are meeting design capability. By
measuring flow, humidity, and temperature variations, we identify the exact root causes of thermal
loss and provide clear restoration options.



#### Preventative Maintenance Programmes

We design custom maintenance plans based on your system's operational criticality, helping you
balance maintenance costs with maximum uptime. Our structured service programmes ensure regulatory
compliance and peak heat rejection.

[View all Services][21]

## Showcasing Our Clients

Auscooling successfully installed a pultruded FRP structure counterflow cooling tower for our Ultra
Mega Power Project in Sasan, Singrauli, Madhya Pradesh. The team demonstrated strong technical
competence and delivered high-quality workmanship throughout the execution and commissioning phases.
We found their performance to be reliable, efficient, and fully satisfactory.

Reliance Infrastructure L

maintain high-performance cooling systems that help industrial plants and HVAC operations run
safely, reliably, and efficiently.



environmental footprint.



#### Bespoke Configurations

Every plant has unique requirements. We configure each system to match your physical site layout and
specific thermal load requirements.



#### Optimised Power Usage

targeted water temperatures.



#### Durable Construction

Using corrosion-resistant structural components, our towers are built to last in highly saline or
industrial atmospheres.



Keep your towers running safely with scheduled inspections, component replacements, and thermal
upgrades designed to extend structure life.



We audit existing cooling towers to identify bottlenecks, upgrading fills and nozzle distribution
systems to reclaim lost thermal capacity.

## Serving Vital Sectors



## Power Generation

Optimising turbine performance and heat rejection in high-capacity power stations.



hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan
**aman**.

## in Tajikistan

Our firm is a full service intellectual property practice based in Tajikistan. We advise and
represent businesses, inventors, universities, and international companies on the protection,
management, and enforcement of intellectual property rights.

Our attorneys and patent agents are officially registered and authorized to act before the national
intellectual property authorities. We combine in depth knowledge of local legislation with
international IP standards to ensure effective and reliable protection of our clients’ innovations
and brands.

[ Learn More About us ][40]
* Services

## Intellectual Property Services in Tajikistan

Full-service patent and trademark attorneys representing local and international clients before the
intellectual property authorities of the Republic of Tajikistan.

### PATENTS

We provide full patent services in Tajikistan, including:
* Patent searches and patentability assessments
* Drafting and filing patent applications
* Prosecution before the patent office
* PCT national phase entry in Tajikistan
* Patent maintenance and renewals

### TRADEMARKS

Our trademark services include:
* Trademark searches and clearance
* Filing and registration
* Opposition and cancellation proceedings
* Recordal of assignments and licenses
* Trademark renewals

### INDUSTRIAL DESIGNS

We assist clients with:
* Design searches
* Filing and registration of industrial designs
* Renewal of registered industrial designs

### COPYRIGHT

We advise on copyright protection for:
* Literary and artistic works
* Software and databases
* Licensing and assignments

### IP STRATEGY & ENFORCEMENT

Our IP Strategy & Enforcement services include:
* IP portfolio management
* Infringement analysis, legal opinions and risk assessments
* Enforcement actions

[ Learn More ][41]

## why choose us

We combine deep local knowledge with international IP standards to ensure the reliable protection of
your innovations.

### Registered and authorized IP representatives in Tajikistan

### Experience with national and international IP filings

### Multilingual team (Tajik, Russian, English)

### Practical, business oriented legal advice

## How It Works

A simplified four-step process to secure and maintain your intellectual property rights in
Tajikistan.

### Initial Consultation

We assess your invention, brand, or design and advise on protection options.

### Filing

We prepare and file applications in accordance with Tajik legislation and international standards.

### Examination & Prosecution

We communicate with the IP office and respond to official actions.

### Registration & Maintenance

We support post registration matters, renewals, and enforcement.

## Ready to Protect Your Intellectual Property?

Contact our registered patent and trademark attorneys today to discuss your legal requirements in
Tajikistan.

[ Speak with an IP Specialist ][42]

## INTERNATIONAL APPLICANTS

We regularly represent foreign applicants seeking IP protection in Tajikistan. Our firm acts as a
local agent for:
* PCT national phase applications
* Madrid trademark registrations
* Foreign design applications filed directly with the IP Office or via Hague Agreement

Find answers to common questions about intellectual property registration and legal protection in
Tajikistan.

## OUR CEO

Felix Guadarrama is a retired senior detective from North Miami Police Department with over 30 years
of experience. He began his career in law enforcement in 1987 and in 1996 joined the detective unit
where he diversified his experience leading investigations in robberies, human trafficking and
homicides for nearly 18 years. As an investigator, Mr. Guadarrama conducted numerous lie detector
examinations via CVSA, worked as a video editor, and served as an expert witness. He is one of the
original members of the SWAT unit, spending 15 years on the entry team. During his tenure in Law
Enforcement Mr. Guadarrama served as an instructor at the Miami Dade Police Academy teaching courses
in traffic, investigations, and defensive driving. He had the privilege of training with the Secret
Service on Dignitary protection which led to the opportunity to work with President Bill Clinton
during the Summit of the Americas in 1996 and other security details within the Dignitary protection
continuum.



In 2000 Felix founded Executive Protection and Investigative Agency, Inc. (EPI) and for 20 years the
company has been providing a growing portfolio of seamlessly integrated security and intelligence
services to leading businesses, financial organizations, investment management firms, corporations
and private clients.

[Learn More][9]

## SAFETY & SECURITY

Exceeding Your Expectations

### EXECUTIVE PROTECTION & SECURE TRANSPORTATION

Here For You

We serve a diverse portfolio of clients such as Fortune 100 companies and their executives,
celebrities and high-profile/high net-worth individuals in a variety of services like  protection,
secure transportation and special event security services. We work with you to identify your threat
profile and tailor a strategic security plan. Our executive protection services are led by our CEO
and supported by a team of former military and federal, state and local law enforcement personnel
who work together to provide each and every client with the greatest level of care.  Our personnel
come to us highly trained and with proven track records in federal and local law enforcement and the
military.
EPI's services include long- and short-term domestic and international personal protection and
secure transportation as well as residential, office and special event security.

[Bodyguard]

### TECHNICAL SURVEILANCE

Next Level Service

Without your knowledge, surveillance devices can be placed to capture sensitive information.
Information in the wrong hands can compromise the credibility, trust and reputation that individuals
and businesses work decades to build. EPI provides sophisticated and discreet Technical Surveillance
Countermeasure (TSCM) services—also commonly referred to as “sweeps”—that are conducted by
experienced technicians equipped with advanced TSCM equipment.



Physical Inspection

Determines evidence of any covert video or audio devices, such as cameras or microphone/listening
devices



Electronic Analysis

Determines the presence of radio frequency (RF) transmitting devices—both operating and dormant.

[Handheld Metal Detector]

Assess, Strategize, Monitor and Implement

Whether you need an independent assessment of security gaps within your organization, a trusted
partner to advise on residential security measures or security/crisis management training, EPI’s
security consulting team can help.

## SAFETY & SECURITY

Exceeding Your Expectations

### EXECUTIVE PROTECTION & SECURE TRANSPORTATION

Here For You

We serve a diverse portfolio of clients such as Fortune 100 companies and their executives,
celebrities and high-profile/high net-worth individuals in a variety of services like  protection,
secure transportation and special event security services. We work with you to identify your threat
profile and tailor a strategic security plan. Our executive protection services are led by our CEO
and supported by a team of former military and federal, state and local law enforcement personnel
who work together to provide each and every client with the greatest level of care.  Our personnel
come to us highly trained and with proven track records in federal and local law enforcement and the
military.
EPI's services include long- and short-term domestic and international personal protection and
secure transportation as well as residential, office and special event security.

[Bodyguard]

### TECHNICAL SURVEILANCE

Next Level Service

Without your knowledge, surveillance devices can be placed to capture sensitive information.
Information in the wrong hands can compromise the credibility, trust and reputation that individuals
and businesses work decades to build. EPI provides sophisticated and discreet Technical Surveillance
Countermeasure (TSCM) services—also commonly referred to as “sweeps”—that are conducted by
experienced technicians equipped with advanced TSCM equipment.



Physical Inspection

Determines evidence of any covert video or audio devices, such as cameras or microphone/listening
devices



Electronic Analysis

Determines the presence of radio frequency (RF) transmitting devices—both operating and dormant.

[Handheld Metal Detector]

### SECURITY CONSULTING

Assess, Strategize, Monitor and Implement

Whether you need an independent assessment of security gaps within your organization, a trusted
partner to advise on residential security measures or security/crisis management training, EPI’s
security consulting team can help.

## OUR CEO

Felix Guadarrama is a retired senior detective from North Miami Police Department with over 30 years
of experience. He began his career in law enforcement in 1987 and in 1996 joined the detective unit
where he diversified his experience leading investigations in robberies, human trafficking and
homicides for nearly 18 years. As an investigator, Mr. Guadarrama conducted numerous lie detector
examinations via CVSA, worked as a video editor, and served as an expert witness. He is one of the
original members of the SWAT unit, spending 15 years on the entry team. During his tenure in Law
Enforcement Mr. Guadarrama served as an instructor at the Miami Dade Police Academy teaching courses
in traffic, investigations, and defensive driving. He had the privilege of training with the Secret
Service on Dignitary protection which led to the opportunity to work with President Bill Clinton
during the Summit of the Americas in 1996 and other security details within the Dignitary protection
continuum.



In 2000 Felix founded Executive Protection and Investigative Agency, Inc. (EPI) and for 20 years the
company has been providing a growing portfolio of seamlessly integrated security and intelligence
services to leading businesses, financial organizations, investment management firms, corporations
and private clients.

  * **Batch editing at catalog scale: **Thousands of images in one job, from the web app or the API.

  * **Brand Kit locks your rules:** Backgrounds, padding, colors, logos, and formats applied
    automatically, with role-based access.

    what ships matches what arrives.

    upfront. Anything that doesn't is regenerated or credited back.

  * **Custom AI models tuned to your catalog:** Trained on your products and brand rules, on
    Enterprise contracts.

    so the same workflow runs as models evolve.
  * **Connects to your stack, across every surface: **Native PIM, DAM, and cloud connectors, on API,
    web, and mobile.

Define your cyber risk in relation to NIST, CIS, SOC 2, ISO, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, and other
industry-recognized standards.

## EXPERT CYBERSECURITY SOLUTIONS PROVIDER FOR GROWING COMPANIES

WE PROTECT GREAT COMPANIES AND THEIR PEOPLE

Your organization is unique. But all too often, cost concerns force mid-market companies to settle
for cookie cutter solutions. Silent Sector provides unbiased vendor and technology-neutral
cybersecurity assessments, guidance, managed cybersecurity services, and program implementation to
keep your company compliant and ahead of the threats. We design solutions for mid-market and
emerging companies in the healthcare, financial services, technology, education, manufacturing, and
defense industries.

[An illustration of virtual data-1]

### Expertise Impact Methodology

Our experts become an extension of your organization

Silent Sector's unique Expertise Impact Model™ streamlines cost and response time by putting you in
direct contact with the experts you need.  Using an asymmetrical warfare approach based on US Army
Special Forces experience, our Expertise Impact Model maximizes capabilities of your internal and
external resources.  This force multiplication methodology also focuses on getting the most value
from your existing software and hardware.  It’s how Silent Sector delivers the high level of
proficiency typically only available to large enterprises, right-sized for the budgets of mid-market
and emerging organizations who need it most.

## EXPERT CYBERSECURITY SOLUTIONS PROVIDER FOR GROWING COMPANIES

WE PROTECT GREAT COMPANIES AND THEIR PEOPLE

Your organization is unique. But all too often, cost concerns force mid-market companies to settle
for cookie cutter solutions. Silent Sector provides unbiased vendor and technology-neutral
cybersecurity assessments, guidance, managed cybersecurity services, and program implementation to
keep your company compliant and ahead of the threats. We design solutions for mid-market and
emerging companies in the healthcare, financial services, technology, education, manufacturing, and
defense industries.

### Expertise Impact Methodology

Our experts become an extension of your organization

Silent Sector's unique Expertise Impact Model™ streamlines cost and response time by putting you in
direct contact with the experts you need.  Using an asymmetrical warfare approach based on US Army

external resources.  This force multiplication methodology also focuses on getting the most value
from your existing software and hardware.  It’s how Silent Sector delivers the high level of
proficiency typically only available to large enterprises, right-sized for the budgets of mid-market
and emerging organizations who need it most.

As a company founded by and staffed with military and law enforcement professionals, our agents

We provide an extensive [range of professional security services][57] to mitigate risks for
organizations in Colorado Springs and the surrounding area. Our agents proudly bring their military

Financial institutions’ pivotal role in society — safeguarding money and valuables — puts them and

monitoring, access control systems and visitor management for comprehensive property protection.

Criminals seek opportunities such as dark, unattended jobsites with valuable materials and equipment
and access control vulnerabilities. Stop them in their tracks with [our expert construction site
security][62] services.

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
* ### What is considered a low voltage electrical service, and how does it differ from standard
  ### electrical work?
  
  Low voltage services involve electrical systems that operate at 50 volts or less, such as network
  cabling, video surveillance, landscape lighting, and audio/video systems. These systems require
  specialized expertise and are typically used for communication, entertainment, and security rather
  than powering appliances.
* ### How do I know if I need structured cabling for my home or business?
  
  Structured cabling is ideal if you need a reliable, organized solution for connecting internet,
  phones, security cameras, and other tech devices. It's especially beneficial for businesses or
  tech-savvy homes that require high-speed data transfer and future scalability.
* ### Can you install and configure all components of a home theater or surveillance system?
  
  Yes, we offer complete setup and installation services for home theaters and surveillance systems,
  including wiring, equipment mounting, system integration, and user training. We ensure everything
  is professionally installed and optimized for performance and ease of use.

  ### electrical work?
  
  Low voltage services involve electrical systems that operate at 50 volts or less, such as network
  cabling, video surveillance, landscape lighting, and audio/video systems. These systems require
  specialized expertise and are typically used for communication, entertainment, and security rather
  than powering appliances.
* ### How do I know if I need structured cabling for my home or business?
  
  Structured cabling is ideal if you need a reliable, organized solution for connecting internet,
